source_context.text: A small transformer uses self-attention to process text and backpropagation to improve its predictions during training. After training, quantization reduces its memory requirements, while retrieval-augmented generation lets it use external documents when answering questions.

gaps.why_useful: The source claims memory reduction occurs but does not explain the bit-width reduction mechanism responsible for this efficiency gain.
